findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_agent_ready, get_history · Private data: get_latest_brief · Public sink: request_asset, request_report_schedule, get_liquidations_weekly · Destructive: get_attention, get_sample_brief, get_audit_sample, get_coverage_heat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_agent_ready, get_history · Private data: get_latest_brief · Public sink: request_asset, request_report_schedule, get_liquidations_weekly · Destructive: get_attention, get_sample_brief, get_audit_sample, get_coverage_heat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
